decisions.reason: As a bread close to the core assortment with no negative signal and low incremental carrying cost in a growing market, it remains a worthwhile option to keep.
A sweet pastry fits the firm's established craft capabilities and likely uses existing inputs and sales channels, so management would usually keep it unless clear weak demand appears.
This newer farmhouse bread has less observed proof than the older products, but because it is adjacent to the core range and inexpensive to continue, the option value still favors keeping it.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen was highlighted as a flagship product and had a gold award, which strongly suggests realized value and supports retaining it as a seasonal focus item.
The premium Christmas stollen also has a gold award and sits close to the firm's established seasonal specialty business, so it is likely to stay unless the range is deliberately simplified.
